newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Sonae Industria sells own shares.
newsitem.headline: Sonae Industria sells own shares.

text.p: Portuguese wood products group Sonae Industria recently sold some of its own stock on Lisbon bourse, a director said.
"It is not very healthy for a company to hold its own shares and as there were (good) conditions in the market to place them, the shares were sold," Carlos de Aguiar told Reuters.
In recent days more than 200,000 of Sonae Industria's own shares were sold, representing more than one percent of its capital of 19.122 billion escudos.
Since the start of the year, shares in Sonae Industria have risen about 80 percent to a high of 2,605 escudos.
Sonae Industria stood at 2,495 escudos, down five, in volume of 11,770 escudos at 1055 GMT.
